comparison.objective: Clamp two boards together using a one-hand bar clamp and leave the clamp self-supporting.
comparison.physical_skill: Jaw insertion and positioning, trigger pumping or sliding-jaw closure, force application, and released clamp stability.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp jaws engage the boards with the required closure/holding state and the clamp remains attached after release; versions change stacked versus edge-to-edge board arrangement. No material-flow or separation requirement exists.
comparison.reason: Shared grasping and release are generic primitives. Clamp actuation and compression of boards do not test granular screening, orientation-dependent aperture passage, spill avoidance, or recovery yield.
